paragraphs: YuJa sells a portfolio of cloud platforms aimed at clients in regulated sectors. The line covers a cloud-hosted video service for storing, managing and streaming media. It also covers online proctoring, described as an automated, AI and live service with full learning management system integration.

Accessibility is handled two ways: a product built for the learning management system, and a compliance product for automated web governance across an organization's websites. For public sector buyers, the company offers to remediate document libraries for local and state governments. The rest of the portfolio adds lecture and screen capture, a real-time classroom polling and quizzing tool, and a note-taking tool designed for student accommodation. Customer service is included with every deployment license.

Published case studies describe deployments at public universities and community colleges, among them a university serving more than twelve thousand students. One community college adopted both the video platform and the accessibility platform together. Staff at another college describe integration with their learning management system through single sign-on and LTI. They also point to captioning that can be translated into other languages as the change that mattered most.
